shortDescription: Applies consolidated system firmware (update/upgrade), VIOS, SR-IOV, and I/O adapter updates, including optional partition migration.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Authentication credentials to connect to the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: IP address or hostname of the target Hardware Management Console (HMC).

options.name: platform_config
options.description: Defines the configuration for the operation to be performed, such as system firmware update/upgrade (including SR-IOV adapter updates) or VIOS updates (including I/O adapter updates). Also supports performing partition migrations.

options.name: state
options.description: C(facts) gathers and returns information about available SR-IOV adapters, Virtual I/O Servers (VIOS), and I/O adapters without making any changes.

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system on which the operations are to be performed.
